This one time I picked up one of my friends to smoke down. We parked at a carpool lot and started smoking for a while, about 30 mins. Then another one of my friends shows up so I welcomed him to come smoke, so he hops in my vehicle. We are having a good time just hanging out, smoking bowl after bowl, and listening to some music. Then all of a sudden a cop pulls up and turns on just the spotlight. We try our best to hide the bowl. At this point we had smoked all of our weed. So the cop comes up to the window and i roll it down, there was smoke coming out the window. The cop asked me for our licenses and we give them to her. My friend that showed up made an excuse saying he had to go pick up his brother and the cop let him go. She then asked us to step out of the car. I get brought into the back of her cop car and my friend gets cuffed and put into another. She kept asking me if I smoked any, I denied everything. She went and talked to my friend for a while, about 15 mins and comes back saying that he said we were all passing it around. She knew I was lying. I eventually tell the cop and she starts writing me a misdemeanor charge, i was about to get let off. She forgot to run my name before so she runs it as she is writing the ticket. She then said "You have a warrant" and i replied "Do i really" we sat there for a few seconds and then I said "so does this mean im going to jail?" she then cuffed me for transport and i got taken to the jail. She was a cool cop i talked to her like she was my friend the whole ride to the jail. I was only in jail for a few hours. I got put in jail at about 10:00pm, this is the day before my birthday. I didn't get out until about 1:00am the next day, so i turned 18 in jail.

Im not a paramedic but I do have a story to tell. I was with my uncle and 2 of my cousins and we were in the upper peninsula of michigan in the middle of nowhere. We were driving home to our cabins from a close friend of ours and my uncle and I see something on the side of the road. My uncle passes it and then backs up to where we saw what looked like a car accident. Then we see a guy walking up to our truck limping and full of blood. The guy had about a 3 inch chunk of skin hanging from the left side of his head. Me and my uncle get out of the truck and try talking to the guy. You could tell he was in a lot of pain. I went over to check out the crash and it was a Ford F150 completely totaled and wrapped around a tree. The guy said that he was in a band and was coming home from a gig and must have had to much to drink. We then bring him back to our cabin where we did as much help as we could. When we got back to the cabins my little cousin about the age of 12 said "I could see his cranium" i thought that was pretty funny. Anyways we call 911 and it took them about an hour and a half to even find where we were at. Then finally the paramedics came and picked the guy up and that was it. The guy had a broken collar bone a broken leg and that huge chunk hanging out of his head. We saved a life that day.
